hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE 'rm -rf|git push.*\b(main|master)\b|git push --force' && { echo 'Blocked: dangerous command (rm -rf, force push or push to main). Use a branch and a PR.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE '(\.env|uv\.lock)$' && { echo 'Protected file, do not edit.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
uv run pytest -q >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Tests are failing. Fix them before handing over.' >&2; exit 2; }
